autopilot_economy_share.g2_note: reported next to the fallback rate

by_model.caveat: an action in a model-mode step may be a duty or an autopilot economy action the brain sent in the same step: the by:model share is an upper bound on model-chosen actions. model_marches below is the exact count of marches.

marches.model_marches_count_basis: per record: min(chosen own-march candidates, sent departs); a recall and a Strike-Order follow are `depart` in the tx too, so they are told apart by the chosen candidates (recall:<handle>, Call-flagged march); a record that chose a recall or a follow beside a march and had the march refused is the one case this can overcount
marches.y_strict_definition: model marches (not a recall, not a Strike-Order follow) whose decision record was opened (section 7.2) and whose army has a public clash_own_* episode of that AI (host id from the opened record, bell not before the march): an EPISODE PROXY for the clash report row (engaged: true), which this report does not read; counted as found, never rounded up
marches.y_proxy_note: Y is an episode proxy. The herald clash rows (engaged: true, contract 10.1) were not read. A clash_own_* episode is created only when an own army fought (contract 5.2) and carries losses, so a clash without a recorded loss can be missed; a later clash of a host id reused by a later march can be credited to an earlier march of the same host.
marches.y_proxy_clash_any_opening_note: NOT Y: the same episode proxy over every model march, opened or not (the record may have been opened; see y_proxy_clash_unopened_only for the unopened ones).

clash_results.note: win = the camp or the enemy stack was cleared (R12); win_pre_r12_unverified = episodes from before R12, labelled a win when the enemy lost more; fought = a clash that cleared nothing; camps_cleared = model marches whose clash also has a camp_cleared_own episode for the same place and bell

citation_among_key_kind_decisions.note: a citation shows the line was shown and named, not that the choice rested on it (5.7)

memory.relevance_spot_check: not run here: the integrator reads 20 opened decisions against the rubric fixed before reading (G14 (b))
memory.probe: see citizens/probe/memory.mjs (its result is not a number of this report)

gets_per_step.note: The brain's own extra GETs, the counters named gets:* only (follow_fetch_gets is the same figure as gets:fetch_path and is not added); gets:reobserve is a lower bound; the first observation of a step and the script bots' GETs are not counted
